raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "7.0.1"
  # dependencies
  lal_version: "8.0.0"
  swig_version: "4.4.1"

recipe:
  name: lalsimulation-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://software.igwn.org/lscsoft/source/lalsuite/lalsimulation-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: d24fc718ed353ed2e637ee8d48f632161601ea4f2a706b5b48e87ba070cea936
  patches:
    - 0001-fix-lalsimulation-patch-bugs-in-conda-activate-scrip.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: lalsimulation-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - help2man >=1.37
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - python
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        # extras for cross-compilation:
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ host_platform }}
            - numpy
      host:
        - gsl
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - libpython
        - numpy
        - pytest
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
        # openmp
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
          else: llvm-openmp
        # extras for make check
        - astropy-base
        - gwpy
    build:
      script: build.sh

  - package:
      name: lalsimulation-data
    inherit:
      from: lalsimulation-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      # these files are the same for every variant, so use a fixed string to only
      # publish one build per platform; variant.ignore_keys must not be used for
      # this as it would also remove the variant pins from the staging environment
      string: ${{ build_number }}
      files:
        - etc/conda/*activate.d/*activate-lalsimulation.*
        - share/lalsimulation/**
    requirements:
      run_constraints:
        - liblalsimulation >=3.1.2
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f ${LALSIMULATION_DATADIR}/LIGO-P1200087-v18-AdV_DESIGN.txt.gz
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Simulation Library data files
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Simulation Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the data files needed to run various applications
        and routines that use the LAL Simulation library.

  - package:
      name: liblalsimulation
    inherit:
      from: lalsimulation-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        # headers
        - include/lal/*LALSim*.h
        # SWIG interface files
        - include/lal/swiglalsimulation.i
        - include/lal/SWIGLALSim*.i
        # libraries
        - lib/liblalsimulation.*
        # pkg-config
        - lib/pkgconfig/lalsimulation.pc
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - gsl
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lalsimulation-data', exact=True) }}
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - libpython
        - python
        # openmp
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
          else: llvm-openmp
      run:
        - gsl
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lalsimulation-data', exact=True) }}
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - libpython
        - python
      run_constraints:
        - lalsimulation >=2.5.0
        - python-lalsimulation >=2.5.0
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('liblalsimulation', upper_bound='x') }}
    tests:
      # check library
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - lalsimulation
      # check pkg-config
      - script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${{ version }}" lalsimulation
        requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Simulation Library shared object libraries
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Simulation Library for gravitational wave data
        analysis.
        This package contains the shared-object libraries needed to run
        applications that use the LAL Simulation library.

  - package:
      name: python-lalsimulation
    inherit:
      from: lalsimulation-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/lalsimulation/**
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - python
      host:
        - gsl
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('liblalsimulation', exact=True) }}
        - numpy
        - python
        # openmp
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
          else: llvm-openmp
      run:
        - astropy-base
        - gwpy
        - gsl
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('liblalsimulation', exact=True) }}
        - mpmath >=1.0.0
        - numpy
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - scipy
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - liblalsimulation
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalsimulation
            - lalsimulation.nrfits
            - lalsimulation.tilts_at_infinity
            - lalsimulation.gwsignal
          # the autotools build doesn't install Python package metadata
          pip_check: false
      - files:
          source:
            - test/python/**
        requirements:
          run:
            - pytest >=4.0.0a0
        script:
          # only test with pytest on native platform,
          # tests run _very_ slowly when cross-compiling
          - if: build_platform == host_platform
            then: python -m pytest -ra -v test/python
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Simulation Library Python bindings
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Simulation Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the Python bindings of the LALSimulation C libraries
        and additional Python modules.

        Note: this package only provides the importable Python libraries.
        All command-line interfaces, scripts, and executables are
        part of the `lalsimulation` package.

  - package:
      name: lalsimulation
    inherit:
      from: lalsimulation-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        # executables
        - bin/lalsim*
        # user env scripts
        - etc/lalsimulation-user-env.*
        # manuals
        - share/man/man*/lalsim*
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - gsl
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('liblalsimulation', exact=True) }}
        - python
      run:
        - gsl
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('liblalsimulation', exact=True) }}
        - mpmath >=1.0.0
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('python-lalsimulation', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - lalsimulation_version --verbose
          - lalsim-bh-qnmode -l 0 -m 0 -s 0
          - lalsim-bh-ringdown -M 10 -a 0 -r 100 -e 0.001 -i 0 -l 2 -m 2
          - lalsim-bh-sphwf -a 0 -l 2 -m 2 -s 0
          - lalsim-burst -w SineGaussian -q 10 -f 100 -H 1e-21 1> /dev/null
          - lalsim-detector-noise -C -t 1 -r 10
          - lalsim-detector-strain --help
          - lalsim-inject --help
          - lalsim-inspiral > /dev/null
          - lalsim-ns-eos-table -n ALF1 1> /dev/null
          - lalsim-ns-mass-radius -n ALF1 1> /dev/null
          - lalsim-ns-params -n ALF1
          - lalsim-sgwb --geo -t 1 -r 100 -W 1 1> /dev/null
          - lalsim-unicorn --help
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Simulation Library
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Simulation Library for gravitational wave data
        analysis.

about:
  homepage: https://wiki.ligo.org/Computing/LALSuite
  documentation: https://docs.ligo.org/lscsoft/lalsuite/lalsimulation/
  repository: https://git.ligo.org/lscsoft/lalsuite.git
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: LSC Algorithm Simulation Library
  description: |

    analysis.
